visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a man in multicam military gear and sunglasses crouched on concrete. He points forward while another young man with a fresh buzz cut wearing green camouflage fatigues walks toward the camera, touching his head. The background features green trees and military machinery under clear, bright daylight. (2) In a split-screen view, the man in multicam yells and points toward an open area, while the recruit in green camo stands with a perplexed facial expression. Bright yellow and white subtitles appear on screen. The lighting is harsh and direct, typical of midday sun on a paved drill ground. (3) The recruit stands at attention in the center of the frame, facing away from a camouflage-patterned watchtower. The sergeant character in multicam stands nearby, inspecting him. The ground is flat, light-colored concrete, and the shadows are short and sharp. (4) The scene shifts to the recruit on the ground performing push-ups. He is smiling and grimacing simultaneously, showing physical exertion. The sergeant crouches beside him, gesturing with his hands while criticizing the recruit's form. The recruit's camouflage uniform is dusty from the ground.
